node.title: Re: where is whatsnew or changes in strawberry perl package
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
The release notes in general are at [http://strawberryperl.com/releases.html]. For example, for strawberry-perl-5.26.1.1-64bit-portable.zip, they are [http://strawberryperl.com/release-notes/5.26.1.1-64bit.html|here]. AFAICT they are not contained in the ZIP archive itself, although the archive does contain a file "win32/Strawberry Perl Release Notes.url" that points to the correct URL.

Update: The archive also contains the usual [doc://perldelta] at perl/lib/pods/perldelta.pod, although that is just for the general Perl release and not specific to Strawberry Perl.
